sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

rows: [CARDINALITY] gen:I2_032ShipShape / nltl:hasStructuralMember: The structural-member relationship has no sh:minCount. A targeted ship with no structural member therefore bypasses all member-owned mandatory operands and the SPARQL calculation, incorrectly conforming without frame spacing, selected hull area factor, or required transverse frame shear area. Required change: Add sh:minCount 1 to the nltl:hasStructuralMember property constraint so the calculation cannot be skipped through a missing member relationship. | [INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] gen:I2_032ShipShape / nltl:frameSpan: The candidate makes nltl:frameSpan mandatory even though the authoritative canonical input for this requirement is nltl:span and the calculation uses nltl:span. Requiring both properties rejects ships that provide the required span but not the unrelated duplicate frameSpan value. Required change: Remove the mandatory nltl:frameSpan property constraint and retain nltl:span as the frame-span input used in the LL calculation. | [WRONG_TARGET] gen:HullAreaValueOperandShape: This standalone shape targets every nltl:hullAreaValue and requires nltl:hullAreaFactor, although I2-032 targets ships and uses the member-owned nltl:selectedHullAreaFactor as AF. The unrelated target creates additional conformance failures outside this requirement. Required change: Remove gen:HullAreaValueOperandShape or at minimum remove its sh:targetClass so it does not impose an independent hullAreaValue constraint for I2-032.

[WRONG_THRESHOLD] gen:I2_032ShipShape sh:sparql: The comparison enforces actual shear area against the tolerance-adjusted reported required area rather than directly against the formula-derived required area. Because the reported value may be below the formula result by the allowed tolerance, the candidate can accept an actual area that is below the regulatory A_t boundary. Required change: Compare (?actualArea * 10000) directly with ?expectedRequiredArea for the mandatory A_w >= A_t test; any separate consistency check for the reported required area must not weaken or replace that direct comparison.
No concrete blocking defect detected in the current candidate.
